rules: Native content implies mandatory capabilities; optional additions never waive native requirements or evidence policies.
Optional requirements always need a validated alternative. Selection does not fabricate evidence or execute external code.
Provider/browser availability is a separate environment check; configuration does not prove a live provider is healthy.
Package references, activity ownership and declarative policies must also pass package semantic validation.

capabilities.description: Resolve explicit horizontal text direction from language and content metadata; interface controls remain separate.
restrictions: LTR, RTL and auto only; no vertical typography or language-specific writing algorithm.

capabilities.description: Isolate plain educational text using HTML dir/bdi and logical CSS; retain logical Unicode data.
restrictions: Plain text and independent fragments only; no arbitrary rich markup or guarantee of editorial correctness. Directional controls are preserved and flagged, not made harmless by isolation.

capabilities.description: Render an authored illustrated context, optional dialogue cue, clock and item cards; no inference of language or correct answers.
restrictions: Context and cue are public stimulus; producers must exclude models and answer clues from unaided assessments. Illustration is decorative, not a measurement of competence.

capabilities.description: Render exact authored inline language spans; no language detection or arbitrary markup.
Native text inputs with auto direction, original values, selection and composition-aware keyboard handling.
restrictions: Native browser input; tested in Chromium with synthetic composition. Real device IMEs and screen readers require manual qualification.

capabilities.description: Resolve declared activity variant restrictions; operational availability never changes the pedagogical variant.
Filter author-declared answer alternatives by effective variant and explicit required whole forms; never infer equivalences.
Join supplied elements using an explicit literal separator, including no separator.
Count whitespace units, Unicode code points, graphemes or locale-dependent word-like segments.
restrictions: Intl strategies require native Intl.Segmenter; intl_words also requires an explicitly supported BCP 47 locale. Results depend on runtime Unicode/ICU data; not universal linguistic correctness.

capabilities.description: Require an official passing final before entering a later unit.
restrictions: Compiled authenticated courses; installed access is not qualified.

capabilities.description: Open a unit exam after acknowledged practice; collect answers without per-item correction.
restrictions: Compiled authenticated courses; installed exams are not qualified.
Participation is server-acknowledged objective practice, not a claim of attention or mastery.

capabilities.description: Present ordered activities as several parts of one ordinary lesson stage.
restrictions: Presentation grouping only; each activity retains its own grading and completion.
Compiled ordinary lesson experience; installed integration is not qualified.

capabilities.description: One authored, deferred recovery per concept using distinct intervening learning activities and persisted attempts.
restrictions: Optional within-lesson practice, no automatic mastery or completion credit.

capabilities.description: Execute lesson_content using the existing activity interaction.
Execute multiple_choice using the existing activity interaction.
restrictions: Options are distinct and contain the canonical answer.

capabilities.description: Execute true_false using the existing activity interaction.
Execute fill_blank using the existing activity interaction.
Execute ordering using the existing activity interaction.
restrictions: The canonical answer uses exactly the supplied tokens, including repetitions.
Version 1.0.0 preserves space joining; 1.1.0 supports a literal separator and a private canonical source permutation. Occurrences have separate identities.

capabilities.description: Execute short_answer using the existing activity interaction.
Execute writing using the existing activity interaction.
Execute listening using the existing activity interaction.
restrictions: Options are distinct and contain the canonical answer.

capabilities.description: Execute speaking using the existing activity interaction.
Execute flashcard using the existing activity interaction.
Execute review using the existing activity interaction.
Execute quiz using the existing activity interaction.
restrictions: Presentation/participation marker only; not an assessment.

capabilities.description: Compare against canonical answers with declared normalization.
NFC, whitespace, case and configured punctuation/diacritics.
restrictions: Combining marks U+0300–U+036F only when diacritics are ignored; not a morphological analyzer.

capabilities.description: Execute an explicitly referenced fixed assessment.
Execute a declared adaptive skill plan and bank.
Interpret AND completion and estimated mastery policies.
Schedule vocabulary and mistake recall.
Run a finite authored timeline, board and checkpoints.
restrictions: Only actions accepted by lessonActionSchema; learning evidence comes from referenced activities.
Automatic curriculum generation/adaptation is not part of this capability.

capabilities.description: Record up to 20 seconds and save a learner-provided transcript.
Read supplied text using a configured browser locale.
restrictions: Voices vary by device; availability is probed on the client.

capabilities.description: Play an authored audio source.
Control authored audio/video playback.
Transcribe 16 kHz mono PCM WAV audio, up to 20 seconds.
Compare a recording to a canonical reference phrase.
restrictions: Requires a supported locale; probabilistic feedback, not certified mastery.

capabilities.description: Give writing feedback without an official objective grade.
Converse freely with contextual corrections.
Converse with authored objectives and quoted evidence.
Generate a micro lesson from an existing mistake.
restrictions: Requires an existing learner mistake and generated questions are validated before use.

capabilities.description: Explain the current learning context.
Compare a learner description to authored image facts, without reinterpreting the image on each request.
restrictions: Needs an authored image scene and canonical facts; not an image generation/import capability.

capabilities.description: Explain or give an alternative example during a paused interactive lesson.
restrictions: Does not generate a replacement curriculum or automatically establish mastery.

capabilities.description: Search supplied lexical entries and meanings.
Display letters, names and examples.
Compare authored regional terms and examples.
Display authored numbers and examples.
Practice authored numbers in the existing limited notation.
restrictions: ASCII digits, limited currency and ordinal notation; not a universal number parser.
